High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur

 Bench At Jaipur

sentences.text:
S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 4665/2019
M/s Adani Wilmar Limited
 ----Petitioners
 Versus
State Of Rajasthan
 ----Respondent

For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Yash Sharma For Respondent(s) : Mr. Ramesh Choudhary, PP HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJEEV PRAKASH SHARMA Order 10/01/2020 One of the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners in terms of the Section 13(2) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is that notice was to be given to the petitioners providing them opportunity to challenge the report prepared by the Central Food Laboratory by taking an option for getting the sample testing second time in other Central Food Laboratory.

Learned counsel submits that notices given to them for exercising their option was after a period of one year and in the meantime, the original sample had attained the expiry date and therefore, they have lost the opportunity on account of delay in giving them notice and therefore, now the petitioners ought to be acquitted of the charges.

Learned counsel has relied on judgment in the case of Girishbhai Dahyabhai Shah Vs, CC Jani &
Anr. reported in 2009(15) SCC 84 where in such similar circumstances, the Supreme Court has quashed the criminal proceedings.

sentences.text: He relies on (2 of 2) [CRLMP-4665/2019] another judgment in the case of Leela Devi & Ors. Vs. State of Rajasthan & Anr. reported in 2013(1) RLW 51 in support of his arguments.

entities.text: Leela Devi & Ors. Vs. State of Rajasthan & Anr. reported in 2013(1) RLW 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Before this court proceeds to pass orders, on the submission of the petitioners, it finds that there appears to be a fault of the concerned officer authorized under the P.F.A Act to which he has resulted in giving undue benefit to the petitioners by sending a notice after much delay.

However,
before proceedings further against any officer or making any adverse comments, it would be in the interest of Justice that an opportunity of hearing to be provided to such officer as to why the action should not be taken against them for delaying in giving notice to the accused under Section 13(2) of P.F.A. Act and thereby helping the accused petitioners in creating situation as above.
The concerned officer shall remain present in the court on the next date.
